plan: Add a JUnit unit test class for HomeViewModel covering its critical paths (initial feed load and the like-video reducer), plus the kotlinx-coroutines-test dependency needed to control viewModelScope's Main dispatcher.
steps: Add kotlinx-coroutines-test to the version catalog (gradle/libs.versions.toml): a coroutines version aligned with Kotlin 2.2.10 and a 'kotlinx-coroutines-test' library entry.

Create app/src/test/java/com/example/myapplication/home/HomeViewModelTest.kt with a MainDispatcherRule (Dispatchers.setMain(StandardTestDispatcher()) in @Before, Dispatchers.resetMain() in @After) so viewModelScope.launch is controllable in tests.
Test initial load: after construction (init dispatches LoadFeed), advancing the dispatcher yields state with the 6 mock videos and isLoading == false.
Test like reducer: onIntent(HomeIntent.LikeVideo) with a known id increments only that video's likes by 1 and leaves the other videos unchanged.
Test like with unknown id: onIntent(HomeIntent.LikeVideo) with an id not in the feed leaves the videos list unchanged (no crash, no mutation).
Run ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest to confirm all tests pass.
